title: Edit G/L Budgets in a Spreadsheet inside Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting)

chapters.title: Creating and Configuring a Budget Region
Working with Multiple Regions and Compare Periods

features.name: Budget regions in spreadsheets
features.description: Areas of a spreadsheet that are linked to Business Central data, allowing users to edit GL budgets directly in a spreadsheet interface with Excel-like functionality.

features.name: Budget formulas in spreadsheets
features.description: Users can enter spreadsheet formulas directly into budget cells that calculate results and update the underlying budget ledger entries in Business Central.

features.name: Comparison periods for budgets
features.description: The ability to add a comparison column showing actuals from a previous period, with configurable date formulas to compare different year ranges.
caveats: requires manual configuration of date formulas

features.name: Dimension support in budget regions
features.description: Budget regions can be configured to show details for specific dimensions, allowing users to build out budgets with dimension breakdowns.
caveats: requires manual recalculation when changing dimension settings

features.name: Access control for spreadsheets
features.description: Users can define who has access to specific spreadsheets, enabling delegation of budget entry tasks to specific departments or individuals.
